objects.name: Detection technique coverage: windows-runmru-registry-key-or-value-deleted
objects.description: The following analytic detects the deletion or modification of Most Recently Used (MRU) command entries stored within the Windows Registry. Adversaries often clear these registry keys, such as HKCU\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Explorer\RunMRU, to remove forensic evidence of commands executed via the Windows Run dialog or other system utilities.
